overview_description.description:
Mazadat is an innovative X2C auctioning and e-commerce marketplace platform where individuals (C2C) and businesses (B2C) sell their items and products (used or new) using a time-boxed auction, a fixed-price Buy-Now listing or a hybrid format, while buyers enjoy the combined variety of offerings in one place.
 
Mazadat bridges innovatively the online and offline worlds through complementing the online platform with an ever-expanding network of decentralized physical service centers to enable efficient, convenient, safe and secure drop-offs and pick-ups of goods and orders, provide users with the convenience, personal safety, security, privacy and anonymity they need, and simultaneously support merchants and vendors with the storage, logistics and fulfilment quick ops to take their businesses to the next level while growing their brands.
